propositions: BindingLifecycle must extract bind, confirm, unbind, reverse cleanup, and numeric-ID re-key transition rules from BindingStore while preserving all existing behaviors exactly.
bind_confirm must remain last-writer-wins on forward entry and pop exactly one differing old reverse key, with no sweep, no ambiguity detection, and no abort.
Stale reverse entries must be removed only in four permitted cases: bind_confirm rebind, unbind, re-key, and _retire.
Numeric-ID re-key must move issues by swapping both indexes instead of retiring them, resetting absent_404_count and stamping updated_at.
note_absent_or_rekey must remain facade-owned as coordinator, delegating only the re-key mutation (step 4) to BindingLifecycle.rekey and falling through to note_absent on negative result.
Every valid transition must leave at most one forward and one matching reverse identity entry, verified by table-driven tests reloading both indexes from disk.
